hardware.host_class: development; tight release timing gates require dedicated host

additional_release_families.status: pending source-provenanced fixtures before P7 tuning

additional_timelines_required: one-step (characterize original public single-row failure separately)
physical_work.outputs: UTCI and all ten save flags enabled; charge promised SVF ZIP/NPZ exports; exact cache-dependent duplicate rules
physical_work.additional_output_plans: default and all-off, paired exactly across implementations
physical_work.logical_tile_settings_rule: Use fixture-specific overrides; 3600/20 are the larger-family settings, not the measured small-case settings.

cache_regimes.first_use: fresh process; empty candidate JIT and geometry caches; imports/JIT/I/O included
cache_regimes.compiled_geometry_cold: fresh process; compiled cache allowed and recorded; geometry absent
cache_regimes.geometry_warm: fresh process; hash-validated prepared geometry; cache loading and requested output included; exclude preprocessing consistently
cache_regimes.kernel_only: preloaded inputs, explicit startup/I/O exclusions; never end-to-end claim

native_configs.processes: Preserve documented upstream policy for default; any tuned worker budget explicitly logged without reducing workload

selection: For each workload/regime use the lowest median among all prespecified valid upstream configurations; report default separately. No universal four-thread optimality assumption. Record failing configurations, never drop them silently.

repetitions.expensive: Fewer only with recorded resource/time justification before assessing speed, raw trials and uncertainty retained

resource_policy.limit_action: Preflight or monitored abort with explicit resource-unavailable/failure status; never shrink logical tile or physics. Estimates do not count as executed measurements.
resource_policy.memory_measurement: 20ms sampled process-tree RSS plus estimator/inventory; label shared-page duplication and sampling limitations

numerical_prerequisite: benchmarks/protocols/comparison_v1.json and artifact equivalence; reject performance claim on a failing comparison

predeclared_goals_not_measured.scope: medium/large workloads; small startup-sensitive cases reported separately with no relative-speed gate
predeclared_goals_not_measured.cuda_superiority_claim: not a gate; no claim without matching hardware measurements

remaining_release_requirements: state and component accuracy on expanded fixtures

cold.effective_kwargs: Per-fixture kwargs plus absolute base_path and own_met_file; initial small source reports/initial_kwargs.json

warm.geometry: Copied prepared_inputs from the same fixture and original logical tile settings; cache loading and all requested outputs included
